name: Eientei ni Homestay!
original_name: 永遠亭にホームステイ!
source:
Medicine is shut in within the Suzuran fields and vigorously avoids interacting with others.
But one day, the judge of the dead, Eiki Shiki, orders her to go out.
However, Medicine has no other option than to head to the Eientei.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ230137.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
医学被封闭在铃兰领域内，极力避免与他人接触。
但有一天，死亡审判官志木英树命令她出去。
然而，麦迪逊别无选择，只能前往永恩亭。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ230137.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
